narrative.overview:
The PtitGo design system unifies PtitGo (apps/customer) and PtitGo Tài Xế (apps/driver) around calm, sunlit clarity and decisive, one-handed control. Every interface behaves like a dependable co-pilot at dusk or midday: neutral cool-stone canvases stay quiet, high-contrast ink carries addresses and VND fares effortlessly, and brand color is reserved strictly to signal the active role—Coral Crimson for customer trip requests and Deep Emerald for driver readiness and verification.

Rather than relying on drop shadows or heavy boxes to separate information, PtitGo builds clear visual hierarchy exclusively through flat tonal surface steps, generous touch geometry, and strict Material Design 3 + Apple HIG platform respect.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-Brand, Single System: Shared primitives, spacing, shapes, and semantic role names via @datxe/ui, swapping only the active brand token family (customer vs driver) across light and dark appearances.

Borderless Tonal Layering: Cards and action containers sit flat (mode="contained", zero drop shadows, zero decorative borders), separated solely by contrast between #F3F4F6 canvas and #FFFFFF surfaces in light mode (#121212 and #1E1E1E in dark mode).

Outdoor-Ready Legibility & Touch Ergonomics: Material type roles scaled up +2 in createMaterialTheme, minimum 48dp primary touch buttons, tabular-nums on fares and timers, and honest semantic state containers.

rules.name: The Single-Brand Accent Rule
rules.body: Customer screens never import Driver emerald primary tokens for main CTAs, and Driver screens never expose Customer crimson—both apps consume the same semantic colors.primary token resolved by ThemeProvider brand.

rules.name: The Token-Only Contrast Rule
rules.body: Raw hex literals and rgba(...) strings are forbidden in app screens and non-theme components (tests/theme.test.cjs); all foreground/background pairs must come from useThemeColors() so Light and Dark modes stay contrast-safe.

rules.name: The Wrap-Before-Shrink Rule
rules.body: Long Vietnamese street addresses, alley numbers (ngõ/ngách), driver names, and user emails must wrap gracefully (flexShrink: 1, minWidth: 0) rather than shrinking font sizes or truncating critical identification data.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Never add drop shadows or mode="elevated" cards to create visual separation; reach for tonal surface stepping (cardSurface over background, or surfaceContainerHigh insets inside cards) instead.

rules.name: The Borderless Container Rule
rules.body: Regular cards, buttons, badges, and list items never carry decorative strokes (borderWidth: 0 via borderlessFrame). Hairline outlines are permitted only in tests/material-design.test.cjs's functionalOutlines allowlist.

dos: Do consume all colors, spacing, typography, and radii through useThemeColors(), useThemedStyles(), and @datxe/ui primitives (Button, Card, Typography, Input, ThemedTextInput, ScreenWrapper).
Do preserve flat tonal hierarchy (cardSurface over background) and zero-border containers (borderlessFrame) across both Light and Dark themes.

Do enforce >= 48×48 dp (Android) / >= 44×44 pt (iOS) interactive touch targets, full safe-area insets (ScreenWrapper / useSafeAreaInsets), and dynamic font wrapping for long Vietnamese addresses, names, and emails.
Do use fontVariant: ['tabular-nums'] for VND prices, wallet balances, distances, and driver offer countdowns.
Do test and maintain every state (loading, empty, error, success, disabled) and respect useReducedMotion().
donts: Don't introduce raw hex/rgb()/rgba() literals inside apps/*/src/** or non-theme UI files (tests/theme.test.cjs enforces this).
Don't add shadowColor, shadowOpacity, elevation, boxShadow, or Card mode="elevated" outside the single approved Customer Home search exception (homeStyles.ts).
Don't add decorative borderWidth to buttons, badges, or cards outside functionalOutlines in tests/material-design.test.cjs.
Don't use white text/icons on rideDropoff (#F2B705) yellow badges (1.8:1 failure—use dark onRideDropoff #1B1B1F), or warningContainer as dark-mode text color.
Don't shrink critical addresses, prices, or emails with adjustsFontSizeToFit or numberOfLines={1} where full decision context is needed.
